claims.content: The Auctioneer schedules new auction events by selecting products, applying event profiles or manually setting auction parameters (such as opening bid, duration, and ending time), and creating grouped auction schedules for future dates.

goal.raw_text: The Auctioneer schedules new auction events by selecting products, applying event profiles or manually setting auction parameters (such as opening bid, duration, and ending time), and creating grouped auction schedules for future dates.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer must have access to the Create New Auctions page to begin scheduling.
At least one product must exist in the system that is eligible for scheduling (i.e., has an available image and is in a valid, sellable inventory location).
The Auctioneer must be able to search and select a list of auction products before editing or scheduling them.
The Auctioneer accesses the Create New Auctions page to begin scheduling new auction events.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer accesses the Create New Auctions page to begin scheduling new auction events.

claims.content: After creating an auction group, the Auctioneer can choose to either apply an existing 'event profile' to the group for faster setup, or create the auction manually by individually setting each item's opening bid, bid increment, duration, and ending time.

When setting the auction duration, the Auctioneer can select from a list of standard durations (e.g., 20-Minute, 1-hour, 1 Day) or choose to schedule alternative durations by manually entering specific starting and ending dates/times.

If the Auctioneer attempts to apply an event profile restricted to a specific category (e.g., 'Apply to Gemstones Only') to a group of items that does not match that category (e.g., jewelry), the system generates an error message preventing the action.

Before the auction is created, if any selected items have additional quantities already scheduled in overlapping auction events, the system displays a warning (preferably via a popup window) to the Auctioneer.

If the Auctioneer attempts to apply an event profile restricted to a specific category (e.g., 'Apply to Gemstones Only') to a group of items that does not match that category (e.g., jewelry), the system generates an error message preventing the action.
A new auction event or group of auction events has been successfully created and scheduled for future dates.
Selected products are assigned to the newly scheduled auction events with specified parameters (opening bid, duration, ending time).
If an event profile was applied, its parameters (bid increments, durations) are inherited by the scheduled items; if manual, individually set parameters are saved.
The system has calculated and set the opening time for each auction item based on the entered duration and ending time.
The Auctioneer receives visual confirmation of successful scheduling via the Create New Auctions page interface (e.g., updated list or success message).
